## Summary
Brief description of the change.

## Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (import, export, or a new geometry/attribute carried over)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance

## Changes
- What was changed and why

## Testing
- How this was verified - which `.skp` fixture(s), `blender --background
  --python tests/...` output, or a real interactive Blender session.
  Include numbers where they exist (mesh/triangle counts, timing) rather
  than "works fine."

## Checklist
- [ ] `tests/test_import.py` and `tests/test_export.py` pass (`blender --background --python tests/test_import.py`, etc.)
- [ ] README updated if this changes what's supported or verified
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in
